phase: Phase 28: Dedicated UI/UX Evolution (Zero-Scroll Tactical Cockpit)

stories.title: Android Jetpack Compose Zero-Scroll Tactical Cockpit Integration
stories.description: Refactor HomeScreen.kt in :app:sharedUI into a clean zero-scroll tactical cockpit adhering to ADR-014. Integrates TactileAvionicsHeader.kt (RF link, mesh status, battery chips), TactileChannelDial.kt (skeuomorphic rotary detents), ExpressivePttActuator (160dp master actuator), ExpressiveVuMeter (14-segment phosphor decay), and GuardedSosSwitch (mil-spec safety flip-cover). All secondary diagnostics tucked into gesture-driven bottom sheets.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero-scroll cockpit layout fits entirely within primary viewport on standard phone displays
Integrates ExpressivePttActuator, ExpressiveVuMeter, GuardedSosSwitch, TactileAvionicsHeader, and TactileChannelDial
Monospaced tabular telemetry labels for jitter-free readouts
100% test pass on JVM and Android targets

stories.title: iOS 100% Native SwiftUI Tactical Cockpit Integration
stories.description: Refactor ContentView.swift in :app:iosApp into a zero-scroll tactile cockpit adhering strictly to Rule 1 and ADR-014. Integrates TactileAvionicsHeader.swift, TactileChannelDial.swift, TactilePttButton, TactileVuMeter, and GuardedSosSwitch with .liquidGlassBackground() and TactileHaptics feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% native SwiftUI without shared Compose UI (Rule 1)
Zero-scroll tactical cockpit layout with liquid glass overlay cards
Tactile channel dial with selection haptic clicks
Clean compilation on iOS simulator target

stories.title: Glove-Friendly Spatial Radar & Telemetry Liquid Glass Card Integration
stories.description: Refactor ProximityRadarView.kt and iOS ProximityRadarView into sleek Liquid Glass HUD cards floating over real-time spatial vectors, topo trail contours, and convoy telemetry, featuring quick-range zoom toggles (50m/250m/1000m) with 84dp glove targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Frosted liquid glass translucent card floating over radar vectors
Monospaced tabular distance and bearing chips

stories.title: Tactical Cockpit E2E Interaction Simulation & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement TacticalCockpitInteractionTest.kt verifying PTT engagement, rotary channel changes, guarded SOS flip-cover state transitions, and audio meter telemetry updates. Updates Archify architecture specification with Sprint 31 Tactical Cockpit showcase card.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E interaction simulation verifies zero-scroll cockpit state transitions
Clean Gradle test passes across JVM and Android targets
Archify architecture specification updated with 9/9 verification checks passed
